title: Sea Rogue Fishing Charters

services.name: Book A Charter
services.desc: Sea Rogue Fishing Charters, sailing from Freeport, Long Island, New York provides private fishing adventures for smaller groups of three to four anglers. We’ll personalize a trip that’s right for you...whether you’re a hard-core fisherman who wants to run offshore, or you want to relax with the family and catch fish in the bay. Fishing is meant to be fun and we know you will have a great time. Long Island’s south shore near Jones Inlet boasts some of the finest saltwater fishing anywhere, and Sea Rogue Fishing Charters will make sure you take full advantage of all the great angling possibilities these waters offer.
